locator: 2012 dissertation, chapter VII, printed p.157, causation reply and footnote211: total or complete cause and all objects participating in causing the effect
interpretation: Explicit WEAKER CONSEQUENCE reading of total or complete cause as the sum of ALL objects participating in causing its effect: each participant is contained in that cause, formalized only with existing Covers. Do not identify full mereological fusion with this upper-bound clause or infer a cause from an arbitrary cover. Footnote211 discusses participant-sum objecthood separately; this policy quantifies only over causes already supplied by the graph and does not prove object eligibility or existence of a cause. Causing a part is NOT silently identified with participating in producing the whole, and all participants belong to one selected causal context, not a union of alternative histories. The entire pinned ChapterVII reply range printed154–158/PDF156–160 was materialized and read, with p157 reread before this extraction.
